facts.fact: IRRI says it, the Senegalese agricultural research institute ISRA and sarmap piloted the RIICE platform using Sentinel-1A, Landsat 8/9 and Sentinel-2 data to map rice area, track cropping seasons and simulate yields in Senegal's rice regions.

systems.system: RIICE (Remote Sensing-based Information and Insurance for Crops in emerging Economies)
systems.platform: Sentinel-1A, Landsat 8/9, Sentinel-2, ORYZA crop model
